headline.title: Amid hardware legal battle, OpenAI releases a $230 keyboard for Codex
headline.summary: OpenAI has launched a $230 light-up keyboard intended for use with its Codex coding app, despite being embroiled in a legal dispute with Apple over allegations of hardware trade theft. The keyboard is designed to enhance the user experience for developers utilizing OpenAI's coding technology.

articles.title: Meet GPT-Red: an LLM super-hacker OpenAI built to make its models safer
articles.summary: OpenAI has developed an advanced language model named GPT-Red, designed to enhance the security of its other models by simulating cyberattacks. The latest version of its flagship model, GPT-5.6, has been strengthened through training against GPT-Red, resulting in improved defenses.

articles.title: SpaceX slips below its $135 IPO price ahead of Starship launch
articles.summary: SpaceX's stock has dipped below its $135 IPO price as anticipation builds for the upcoming Starship launch, reflecting a decline from its initial post-IPO highs. This downturn suggests a shift in market sentiment regarding the company's future prospects and CEO Elon Musk's prior commitments.

articles.title: AI slop movies are the new direct-to-video cash grabs
articles.summary: The article discusses the rise of AI-generated films, likening them to direct-to-video cash grabs, as audiences flock to theaters for high-profile releases like Christopher Nolan's adaptation of The Odyssey. The film is projected to earn between $80-$100 million in its opening weekend, highlighting the contrast between traditional filmmaking and the emerging trend of AI in cinema.

articles.title: GPT-Red: Unlocking Self-Improvement for Robustness
articles.summary: OpenAI has introduced GPT-Red, an automated red teaming system designed to enhance AI safety and alignment through self-play techniques. This system aims to improve robustness against prompt injection attacks.

articles.title: Suno snatched millions of songs from YouTube, Genius, and Deezer
articles.summary: A hacking incident has revealed that the AI music generator Suno was trained using millions of songs and lyrics scraped from platforms such as YouTube Music, Deezer, and Genius. The disclosure raises concerns about the transparency of Suno's training datasets and their acquisition methods.

articles.title: Thinking Machines amps up its bet against one-size-fits-all AI with its first open model, Inkling
articles.summary: Thinking Machines has launched its first open AI model, Inkling, marking a significant step in its development after a year and a half of building AI infrastructure. The company aims to challenge the one-size-fits-all approach in AI with this new offering.

articles.title: AI Isn’t Smarter Than a Baby—Yet
articles.summary: Researchers suggest that the cognitive development of babies, characterized by their ability to learn and adapt, could inspire future advancements in AI architecture. Understanding how infants process information may lead to more sophisticated and efficient AI systems.

articles.title: Whatnot acquires Shaped to power real-time live shopping recommendations
articles.summary: Whatnot has acquired AI startup Shaped to enhance its real-time live shopping recommendations and search capabilities. This acquisition aims to improve personalization and discovery features as Whatnot expands into new product categories.

articles.title: Rime picks up $24M Series A to help enterprises field customer calls
articles.summary: Rime has raised $24 million in a Series A funding round to enhance its platform for managing customer calls for enterprises. The company currently processes over 100 million calls monthly for various clients.

articles.title: Model Routing Is Simple. Until It Isn’t.
articles.summary: The article discusses the complexities that arise in model routing within AI systems, highlighting that while the concept may seem straightforward, various factors can complicate its implementation. It emphasizes the need for careful consideration of model interactions and dependencies to ensure effective routing in AI applications.

articles.title: OpenAI finally launches hardware… for Codex
articles.summary: OpenAI has launched a new hardware product called Codex Micro, designed to enhance its coding platform, Codex. This release comes amid ongoing developments related to a separate AI-powered device in collaboration with former Apple designer Jony Ive, which is currently facing legal challenges.
